Description:
Travelodge by Wyndham Santa Rosa is near Santa Rosa Route 66 Airport and the famous Blue Hole, a natural pool that is 80 feet deep and a popular dive location. Additional attractions like Santa Rosa Lake State Park, the Billy the Kid Museum and Fort Sumner National Monument are an easy drive away.

Golfing opportunities are available at the nearby Santa Rosa Golf Course and Country Club, and guests can experience the history of the area at the Route 66 Auto Museum.

Visit the giant pool and water slide at Park Lake or hike along El Rito Creek. The hotel is near many area recreational activities and attractions. Santa Rosa, New Mexico is known as the "City of Natural Lakes," and excellent fishing and hiking abounds in the nine area lakes located within minutes of the hotel.

A free continental breakfast and free weekday newspaper will help guests get started with their day. Guests will enjoy many full-service amenities at the hotel, including an indoor pool and hot tub. This is a pet-friendly hotel; extra fees apply.

Business travelers will appreciate additional conveniences like free wireless high-speed Internet access, free local calls and access to a fax machine.
